periods.summary: Belbet Balt is the old Arcadia imperial guard commander who infiltrated the New Kingdom military. He uses a golden flute to hatch and command Abyss, reveals Lisha's branded hostage past, and is defeated when Lux unleashes Bahamut.

key_events.summary: Reveals himself as an old empire remnant, attacks Lisha, and summons Gargoyle Abyss from the large Abyss body.
Loses to Lux's Bahamut and the original Godspeed/Instant Strike technique.
